text:
maria: Heads-up: vendor pen test booked for Weds 2026-05-06 09:00 PT. Need to finalize RBAC temp creds, KMS access (metadata only), audit log filters/retention, and remediation workflow. Who can own each part?

dav: I can own RBAC changes. Need an explicit list of principals (external testers + our svc account) and duration. Prefer a timeboxed Terraform role binding that we can revoke automatically.

alex: For KMS, testers only need Describe/List (no Decrypt/Encrypt). Suggest creating a dedicated service account and granting roles/cloudkms.viewer at project scope, but deny key-specific permissions. Samir, can you review the exact IAM role?

samir: Yep. I’ll create `pen-test-svc-account@redwood` and add an IAM binding `roles/cloudkms.viewer` on the project. No key access. I’ll also lock down the SA so it can't impersonate other SAs. Will post the TF snippet in this thread.

sre-bot: Deployment window reserved: 2026-05-06 08:30-10:30 PT. Auto rollback enabled on infra drift. :white_check_mark:

kris: Audit logging: enable ADMIN_READ and DATA_ACCESS for the KMS and IAM resources in scope. Also enable CryptoKeyAccessEvents to capture attempted crypto operations even if decrypt isn't allowed. Forward logs to `sec-log-bucket` and Splunk index `pentest`. Retain for 365 days initially.

maria: Important: we want to capture attempted usage against keys (even failures). alex, can you propose a concrete log filter we can use for the Splunk ingestion?

alex: Sure — proposed filter (paste to Cloud Logging export):

```
resource.type="gcp_kms_keyring" OR resource.type="gcp_kms_crypto_key"
protoPayload.methodName:("google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService*" OR "CryptoKey")
logName:projects/redwood-prod/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Fdata_access
```

This targets KMS resource types and Data Access audit events. We can tweak to include failed attempts only (severity>=ERROR) if you want less noise.

dav: For RBAC: I'll create a small TF module that applies a time-limited binding using `google_project_iam_member` and a cron job to remove it after `expiration`. Will post PR by EOD Mon.

maria: Remediation & retest process: create a lightweight JIRA board `PT-2026-05` with columns: Triage, In Progress, Fix PR, Waiting Retest, Resolved. Dav will be triage lead during the test window. Target initial fix PRs within 7 days; retest within 14 days. Is that achievable?

dav: Yes — triage lead during test window. We should triage severity and note whether a config change or code fix.

samir: I'll coordinate retest scheduling. Evidence collection checklist: screenshots, audit log exports, and authorized packet captures if network-level testing needed. Store artifacts at `s3://pentest/2026-05-06/` with README.

kris: +1 on artifacts. Also add an entry in the compliance register for the pen test and mark the expected retest window.

maria: Action items recap: dav: RBAC TF & triage lead; samir: create SA + IAM binding + S3 path; kris: enable audit logs & forward to Splunk; alex: finalize log filters & Confluence page; dav: create JIRA board. Please confirm ownership by EOD Mon.

alex: :thumbsup: I’ll drop snippets and a short runbook in Confluence and link here.

kris: :+1: I’ll enable the exports and post confirmation once tests pass in staging.

samir: Will post the SA TF and S3 path by EOD.

dav: PR for RBAC TF + JIRA board created (will ping when ready).

maria: :eyes: Thanks all. If anyone needs temporary elevated access to validate fixes during the window, open a ticket with exact scope & duration and tag @dav and @samir.

sre-bot: Reminder scheduled: runbook review meeting Tue 2026-05-05 10:00 PT — auto-add to eng-security calendar.

maria: Closing thread for now — will follow up with links to Confluence + JIRA when available. :handshake:
